MyWishes review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: A free UK-based platform to write a will, a 'Digital & Social Media Will', funeral wishes and an advance care plan, then download, print and share them. Best for: People who want a free way to record digital and end-of-life wishes.

Good

Best for

People who want a free way to record digital and end-of-life wishes.

Skip if

you want a lawyer-reviewed will

Pros

  • Free to use
  • Covers wills, digital legacy, funeral wishes and care plans
  • Download, print and share your documents

Cons

  • UK-focused; check the will rules where you live
  • You must print and sign documents yourself
  • No built-in emergency access to accounts

Frequently asked questions

Is MyWishes good for digital legacy planning?

A free UK-based platform to write a will, a 'Digital & Social Media Will', funeral wishes and an advance care plan, then download, print and share them.

Who is MyWishes best for?

People who want a free way to record digital and end-of-life wishes.

How much does MyWishes cost?

Free.

What are the downsides of MyWishes?

UK-focused; check the will rules where you live; You must print and sign documents yourself; No built-in emergency access to accounts.
